exposure: quality improvement initiatives to improve rate of using mother's own milk (MOM)
outcome: exclusive use of MOM at first feed
exclusive use of MOM at full feed
use of any MOM at discharge
cohort: The study participants were preterm infants born at less than 32 weeks of gestation.
finding: Quality improvement initiatives significantly increased the exclusive use of mother's own milk at first feed and any mother's own milk at discharge, and reduced the incidence of necrotizing enterocolitis in preterm infants.
